title: I Built a Flight Simulator in Three.js — Play It in Your Browser
author: Funny-Inflation-8142

comments.author: No_Resolution6826
comments.body: this is amazing, could you please tell how did you make it? which model you used and how the world and assets were added? Thanks great work

replies.author: Funny-Inflation-8142
replies.body: I built the whole project with GPT-6 Astra. The entire world — terrain, textures, vegetation, etc. — is procedurally generated, so there are basically no environment assets. The airplane is the only 3D model in the project, and that was also created with GPT-6.
